d: Pale peach-blonde hair is styled with long, straight lengths and blunt-cut bangs, featuring a high side-ponytail. The eyes are a bright sky blue with a wide, cheerful expression on a face appearing as a young adolescent. A slender build is dressed in a maid outfit consisting of a black dress with a white ruffled apron, a white frilled headband, and short puffed white sleeves. Accessories include a black cat-ear headband with small pink roses and a black ruffled wrist cuff on the right arm.
